latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Sales Enablement Video — the AI video tool for scalable sales training and performance.

- Enables creation of objection handling, discovery, qualification, competitive positioning, and onboarding video libraries.
- Converts existing sales knowledge (call recordings, notes, playbooks) into actionable, instructional video modules.
- Exports video content in multiple formats for LMS, Slack, Notion, and sales enablement platforms.
- Provides short-form, scenario-based, and manager-focused coaching videos.
- Aims to accelerate rep ramp, improve objection handling, and keep teams updated on product and competitive shifts.
